svg.desc: An external node stores a 64-bit key, 10-bit link, 18-bit length encoding and 36-bit offset. An inline node stores the same key and link with a 3-bit tag, 3-bit length and 48-bit payload. Both are 16 bytes. A hello-exclamation value can live in either layout.
svg.title: External values versus six-byte inline values
External values versus six-byte inline values

ns2:Work.dc:title: External values versus six-byte inline values
ns2:Work.dc:description: An external node stores a 64-bit key, 10-bit link, 18-bit length encoding and 36-bit offset. An inline node stores the same key and link with a 3-bit tag, 3-bit length and 48-bit payload. Both are 16 bytes. A hello-exclamation value can live in either layout.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #b96b12; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: round

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #19334b

g.text: Keep a small value in the node you already found.
